Dyno rpm coverage (WOT)
probes.hint: full-throttle pulls through the rev range

probes.label: Tires warm (> 150 F) most of the run

advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 76/158 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 19.70; 4/4 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.311 over 158 corners (99 understeer, 8 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 2413 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 43 stops (4 both-axle, 0 front-first, 3 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.43) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
